decisions.reason: Premium customer support is tightly aligned with the firm's core value proposition, uses existing service capabilities, and appears inexpensive to continue while supporting the hosting business.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's hosting platform and in-house development, so the option still has strategic value and strong complementarities with the established offer.

The data processing contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's core hosting and support activities, and after several years the firm has likely learned enough to see limited upside versus better use of resources in core services and new platform tools.

Scalable hosting for agencies fits the firm's agency-focused strategy, exploits its data center and technical resources, and should remain attractive in a growing market with limited additional uncertainty.
